canonical_protocol_validation: Unavailable: canonical sibling skill/schema source is encrypted VLT1 in this runtime. This is a frozen descriptive execution protocol; no validated ecbench or statistical tier claim.
source_revision: Exact enclosing published commit, separately bound by the S3 checkpoint receipt and deployment request
isolation: Shared Runpod CPU host. Cgroup limits and CPU affinity recorded; L2 not asserted.

primary_inputs.subgroup_path: r approximately 8 B^3, original public curves and P,Q retained
primary_inputs.pool_generation: Fresh native mt19937_64 plus uniform_int_distribution public alpha*P+beta*Q. Frozen pool points are not reused and validation scalars are not read.
primary_inputs.attempt_seed: public_seed + attempt*2654435761 for attempt 0..3, same for every arm and round
primary_inputs.stopping: first informative relation; retain prior misses; four misses are censored. Execution/construction failures stop that arm-target and are retained, not counted as misses.

controls.negative: natural misses in the unfiltered random-labelled panel
controls.positive: fixed paper roots and nonlinear-control.json with an independently checked frozen pair witness
controls.aa: known/known-aa and pullback/pullback-aa timings, same inputs and code; temporal measurement noise rather than new algorithmic randomness
controls.reference: Frozen streamed batched pair algorithm plus original quotient/GCD and paper dense/trace code; strongest-external-tool status not asserted
controls.external_roots: FLINT nmod_poly_roots on identical fixed paper polynomial, randomized external control
controls.rho: Existing prime_fast::rho_parallel through trace_incidence_rho: one thread, negation, table_bits4, walkers8, dp_bits0, max_steps10000000. Configuration is explicit, not a claim of globally optimal tuning.

auxiliary_data.construction: Lazy only for nonlinear selected GCD. Native PARI/GP ellcard/factor/ellgroup, at most128 candidates and15s per invocation; largest prime factor at most1024 and even curve order.
auxiliary_data.basis: Correct PARI second generator with an explicitly charged elllog before native direct-product validation; supplied invariant factors alone are insufficient.
auxiliary_data.isogeny: Classical rational two-isogeny, then independent counted PARI codomain basis construction and native validation. Original target labels stay on the original target curve.
auxiliary_data.failure: Retained construction failure, never free preprocessing or a relation miss

translation_panel.scope: Complete translation with field setup, least nonsquare, collisions and exceptional handling. Frozen support verification is timed separately.

fixed_root_panel.scope: Given literal datum; native validation each call. Isogeny arms additionally construct and validate their complete toy codomain datum each call. FLINT requires no auxiliary datum.

order: Rotate arm order by round; reverse dense/trace translation order on odd rounds. Fixed source/input/seed identities.
timing: Native steady_clock plus getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF+RUSAGE_CHILDREN). Complete cost includes public parsing/validation, pool construction/rejections, misses, any lazy auxiliary construction/validation, norm/GCD, root extraction, witness recovery and original-curve scalar check. Process startup/output and peak RSS additionally recorded by /usr/bin/time. GP time is never omitted.
memory: Fresh process per row; parent high-water RSS and maximum child high-water RSS reported separately. No measured concurrent-sum or allocated-capacity substitution.
failure_policy: Retain nonzero exits, build failures, row timeouts and unfinished global deadline. Do not reduce the matrix or restart a measurement after seeing results.
analysis: Descriptive medians and per-round paired ratios only, with all raw rows and failures. No fitted asymptotic exponent, p-value, fastest-tool claim, L2 claim, leaderboard or tier promotion.
cleanup: External local supervisor collects output, verifies archive hash, uploads to the narrowly scoped approved S3 destination, then DELETEs only the recorded pod; also DELETE on the original absolute deadline.
credentials: Runpod key and temporary upload signing material stay outside Git and remote job. Only a public ephemeral encryption certificate is committed; S3 upload token is encrypted to its private counterpart.

claims.statement: The source-coordinate representation may lower complete cost after all setup and recovery is charged; this run records descriptive evidence rather than a validated speed claim.
